items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah the alto player, Charlie Mariano he was on it.

ctx.x: And also I have “Dear John C.” 1965. So you are still with ‘Trane and what was the inspiration to do this C.D. and that title – the title cut “Dear John C.”
Well that was, I don’t know because I thought that Charlie… the alto player’s, his record date.
Yeah the alto player, Charlie Mariano he was on it.
